newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish-Malaysian firm to make rolling stock.
newsitem.headline: Polish-Malaysian firm to make rolling stock.

text.p: Polish trading firm Kolmex SA and Malaysia's Darian Motors company plan to set up a joint venture in Malaysia to assemble rolling stock for the Asian country's railways modernisation programme, Darian's head said on Tuesday.

Dato Paduka Affendi said during a Polish-Asian economic conference ending on Tuesday that the venture could count on Malaysian government orders for railway coaches worth about $100 million over the next three years.

"The Malaysian government plans to buy quite a number of coaches. We will set up a facility in Malaysia to assemble them," he told reporters. The coaches would be built from Polish-made parts, he added.
State-owned Kolmex SA, Poland's main trader in rolling stock and railway parts, is slated for privatisation.
